+struct AvailableValue:
+    key1: int
+    key2: int
+    key3: int
+    value: i32
+    scope: i32
+    branches: int
+    generation: int
+    epoch: int
+    version_a: i32
+    version_b: i32
+
+ht_entries: AvailableValue[]

 o_epoch = 0

@@ -350,23 +345,23 @@ o_scope_close = ():

+    loop ht_entries[i].epoch == o_epoch:

     i

-    if ht_epoch[i] != o_epoch: return -1

+    if int(ht_entries[i].version_a) != va or int(ht_entries[i].version_b) != vb: return -1
